items.title: VoxLock: Target-Speaker Extraction for Voice Agents Without an Enrollment Step
items.snippet: A voice agent's speech recognizer transcribes everyone near the microphone, including people other than the caller. I fine-tuned a public causal target-speaker extraction model (REAL-TSE, 27M parameters) on one GPU to work from a voice sample cut from the call itself, and released it as VoxLock. I score it by what a recognizer writes on real recordings. On Krisp's 265-recording benchmark it reaches 4.95% WER against 23.21% unprocessed and lets 9 background words into the transcript over 85 minutes of background-only speech. Its WER is not significantly different from Krisp's best filters and is significantly lower than the other commercial and open systems I tested. On 400 AMI meeting window
items.title_ar: VoxLock: استخراج صوت المتحدث المستهدف لوكلاء الصوت دون تسجيل مسبق

items.title: Venus-DefakerOne2: A Vision-Forensics Foundation Model with Broader Coverage
items.snippet: Real-world forgery is inherently heterogeneous: it manifests not only as digital manipulation but also as physical spoofing, and is carried not only by images but also by videos. Despite substantial progress, a unified anti-forgery foundation model covering such a broad threat spectrum remains absent. In this paper, we present Venus-DefakerOne2, which substantially extends the forensic capability boundary along both the forgery-form and media-type dimensions. Trained on tens of millions of open-source and in-house samples, it incorporates two key designs. items.title_ar: Venus-DefakerOne2: نموذج أساسي لكشف التزوير البصري والفيديو
items.summary_ar: يقدم النموذج Venus-DefakerOne2 لكشف أشكال متعددة من التزوير تشمل التلاعب الرقمي والانتحال المادي، في الصور والفيديو. دُرّب على عشرات الملايين من العينات مفتوحة المصدر وداخلية. يعتمد على تقنية Tide-Style-Tuning التي تتبادل بين LoRA والضبط الكامل للمعاملات.

items.title: REA: A Routed Embodied Agent Runtime for Asynchronous Brain-Cerebellum Control
items.snippet: Foundation models are becoming remarkably reliable at high-level reasoning, yet they remain too slow and costly to serve as fine-grained controllers. Conversely, fast policies like VLAs and whole-body controllers offer more efficient reflexes, but struggle to generalize. While pairing a deliberative brain (foundation models) with a reactive cerebellum (fast policies) seems natural for embodied systems, two obstacles remain: methods are built and scored on incompatible stacks, and their asynchronous coordination is difficult. items.title: Latent Reasoning in Continuous Space for Unified Multimodal Models
items.snippet: Unified Multimodal Models (UMMs) achieve remarkable success on diverse multimodal understanding and generation tasks, yet they still struggle to effectively leverage language-based chain-of-thought reasoning for image generation. As a result, existing reasoning-augmented UMMs often fail to inherit the test-time scaling and fine-grained controllability observed in large language models. We attribute this failure to a fundamental modality mismatch: reasoning is performed in a discrete token space, whereas image generation operates in a continuous space. items.title: MemSteer: Turning User Histories into Supervision for Agent Memory Optimization
items.snippet: An effective agent memory system should adapt to a user's history and task requirements. Human-annotated supervision can guide this adaptation by providing feedback for evaluating and improving memory designs. Yet suitable labels are rarely available for new user histories, and manually constructing QA pairs and supporting evidence is costly. We introduce MemSteer, which turns unlabeled user histories into question-answer (QA) supervision with supporting evidence for memory-design optimization. items.title_ar: MemSteer: تحويل سجلات المستخدمين إلى بيانات إشراف لتحسين ذاكرة الوكلاء

items.title: No Channels Left Behind: Understanding Diffusion Acceleration through Residual Gates
items.snippet: Training acceleration methods for diffusion transformers, such as REPA and dispersive regularization, are commonly explained by additional supervision, spatial-structure priors, or improved feature geometry. We revisit this view and uncover a striking internal change: the AdaLN-Zero residual gate α, which directly controls how conditioned updates enter the residual stream, is substantially reorganized by these methods. This observation motivates our hypothesis that acceleration arises, at least in part, from reshaping the residual gating pathway rather than solely from the feature structures explicitly imposed by auxiliary objectives. Supporting this view, accelerated models are markedly mor
items.title_ar: تسريع تدريب Diffusion عبر بوابات الـ Residual
items.summary_ar: تفترض الورقة أن تسريع تدريب diffusion transformers مثل REPA يحدث جزئياً لأن بوابة AdaLN-Zero تُعاد هيكلتها، وليس فقط بسبب الإشراف الإضافي. تدعم الدراسة هذه الفرضية بملاحظة أن النماذج المسرّعة أكثر تأثراً في مسار الـ residual. النص مقتطع ولا يذكر الأرقام.

items.title: SciGame: Let Agents Play the Scientific Discovery Games in the Real and Counterfactual World
items.snippet: Large language model agents are increasingly used for scientific discovery. However, existing benchmarks mix law inference with programming, score data fitting instead of prediction on unseen inputs, and do not separate empirical evidence from pretrained priors. We introduce SciGame, a controlled benchmark that converts scientific literature into structured scientific cards. Each card yields a pair of Original and dimensionally consistent Counterfactual environments with the same task interface. items.title_ar: SciGame: اختبار الوكلاء على اكتشاف القوانين العلمية في عالمين
items.summary_ar: يقدم SciGame معياراً يحوّل الأدبيات العلمية إلى بطاقات علمية، ولكل بطاقة بيئتان أصلية ومضادة للواقع بنفس واجهة المهمة. يضم المعيار مجموعة تاريخية من القوانين المعروفة ومجموعة حيّة من أوراق منشورة بعد تاريخ معرفة النماذج. يقيّم المعيار قدرة الوكلاء على الاستنتاج والتنبؤ على مدخلات غير مرئية.
items.why_ar: قد يكون مرجعاً مفيداً لتقييم وكلاء الاستدلال العلمي إذا كنت تفكر في نشر دراسة تقييم أو بناء اختبارات داخلية.

items.title: Learning Quality-Controllable Robot Policies with Iterative Hindsight Relabeling
items.snippet: Robot policy evaluation often relies on a binary success signal for task completion. In real-world deployment, however, desired execution behaviors are also defined by quality attributes such as execution speed and motion smoothness, which need to be dynamically controlled according to task requirements. To address this, we introduce Quality-Controllable Policy (QCP), a robot policy that enables inference-time control over both individual quality attributes and their combinations. items.title_ar: سياسات روبوتية قابلة للتحكم في الجودة عبر إعادة وسم الماضي
items.summary_ar: تقدم الورقة QCP، وهي سياسة روبوتية تتيح التحكم وقت الاستدلال في صفات مثل السرعة ونعومة الحركة. تضيف حلقة iterative hindsight relabeling تجارب ناجحة تحت أهداف جودة مختلفة لتوسيع المدى القابل للتحكم. النص لا يوضح نتائج قياسية كاملة.
